meta.title: About Bluebolt Services
meta.description: Bluebolt Services connects appliance brands, marketplaces and retail chains with installation technicians. Our mission, how we work and company details.

title: Standardizing after-sales installation
lead: Bluebolt Services connects appliance brands, e-commerce marketplaces and retail chains with a network of installation and maintenance technicians, through one dispatch system and one shared process.

media.team: dispatch team at work in the office

story.title: More than a middleman
story.p1: An installation job passes through many hands: the brand or store, the dispatch team, the technician and the customer. Bluebolt brings them into one process, so brands and marketplaces do not have to find and manage technicians in every locality themselves.
story.p2: We combine automated dispatch with job-by-job quality control: we assign the nearest technician with the right skills, the technician confirms the appointment with the customer, the work is signed off with photos, and we reconcile with the brand once the job is done.
story.p3: For businesses, Bluebolt is a single point of contact for installation, service warranty and reconciliation. For technicians, it is a source of jobs close to home. For customers, it is one hotline to call when they need help.

fast.title: Fast
fast.body: Each job goes to the nearest technician with a free slot, who then calls the customer to fix the appointment time.

standard.title: Precise
standard.body: Technicians follow the five-step process, test-run the unit and sign off with the customer using photos.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.body: Job status, sign-off photos and reconciliation are recorded for every job.
